Dorsey has had a turbulent career in Silicon Valley.

He launched Twitter in March 2006, and two years later, he was booted as the company's CEO.

After his departure, Dorsey launched the financial payments company Square in 2009, which he rebranded as Block in 2021.

He rejoined Twitter in 2015.

He led Twitter through the tech backlash that engulfed social media companies, testifying before Congress multiple times and later stepping down as Twitter's CEO in 2021.

He encouraged Musk's Twitter acquisition the following year.

## Jack Dorsey Bio

Checked by

| Updated

Jack Dorsey is a co-founder, Block Head and chairperson of [Block](https://cryptoslate.com/companies/block/), the payments company formerly called Square.

He also co-founded Twitter, now X, and served two terms as its CEO.

## Block and Bitcoin

Block’s [2026 proxy statement](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1512673/000162828026027203/sq-20260423.htm) identifies Dorsey as its principal executive officer from July 2009 and board chair from October 2010.

His executive title changed from CEO and president to Block Head in April 2022.

Block’s businesses include Square and Cash App, alongside Bitcoin projects Bitkey and Proto.
